nonclaims_verbatim: Nothing is proved at τ = m/N = O(1). All results are fixed-m (diagonal / below Ehrenfest). This is not progress on BGS-BGS-001 or BGS-TRACE-148.
"B_m → 2m" is not claimed. Theorem N covers a finite list of certified NSW primes, and the infinitude of NSW primes is open.
The parity crossover is the derandomized analogue of the known BGOS/Pandey–Mehta symmetry-breaking crossover. It is not a Keating–Mezzadri pseudo-symmetry, and the phenomenon is not new.
The certified decay bound is vacuous below m⁺(η) (10²–10⁵). It says nothing at the numerically accessible m.
Conjecture R is not reduced to any known conjecture or large-sieve inequality. The "quadratic large sieve" phrasing is withdrawn. KR/Bourgain/BGK do not apply (minimal period ord_h λ = m).
The fixed-η CLT is numerical only (m ≤ 11); the KS yardstick is heuristic.
The (m, η) = (11, 2) outlier is unexplained; the torsion attribution is withdrawn.
The Theorem D_cert arithmetic is IEEE float with an a-priori error bound (plus arb coefficients), not full interval arithmetic, until the full directed-rounding rerun.
